name: Jawg Maps
tagline: French OSM map platform with tiles, geocoding, directions, and static maps
description: Jawg Maps is a French mapping platform built on OpenStreetMap data. It provides vector and raster map tiles, geocoding and reverse geocoding, directions/routing, static map images, places search, and elevation. Developers authenticate with an access token; a free tier is available for evaluation and light production use.

auth.details: Access token (access-token query param or Authorization: Bearer). Self-serve signup via Jawg Lab.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available; exact request quotas require pricing page confirmation

use_cases: reverse geocode lat/lon to a place name
request driving or walking directions between points
render map tiles or static map images for a location
